title: Portfolio pages slow and failing
summary: Portfolio and positions pages became slow and returned 5xx errors starting around 14:41 UTC, and some order placements were rejected. The investigation concluded (conclusive) that the primary cause was a degradation in the external quotes‑vendor that caused market‑data‑service latency to jump ~6× and its error rate ~10× at 14:41 UTC; aggressive retries pushed the circuit‑breaker into half‑open at 14:47 UTC, and downstream callers (portfolio‑service, orders‑service) began receiving gRPC DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, which in turn made edge‑gateway time out after its 3 s hard limit. Confidence in this hypothesis (HYP‑1) is 0.65. The exact minute when portfolio‑service latency began to rise remains unknown because per‑minute latency series were not captured (GAP‑4, GAP‑12).

hypothesis.mechanism: The external quotes‑vendor began timing out (800 ms) at ~14:41 UTC. market‑data‑service retried aggressively, its circuit‑breaker entered half‑open at 14:47, and downstream callers (portfolio‑service, orders‑service) received gRPC DEADLINE_EXCEEDED. Edge‑gateway then timed out waiting for portfolio‑service, producing 5xx errors and order rejections.
predictions: Per‑minute market‑data‑service latency_p99_ms and error_rate will jump sharply at ~14:41 UTC (≈6× latency, ≈10× error).
Circuit‑breaker state will transition from closed to half‑open at ~14:47 UTC.
Downstream callers will show gRPC DEADLINE_EXCEEDED starting at 14:42 UTC.

objections.detail: Per‑minute portfolio‑service latency_p99_ms and error_rate series were not returned (GAP‑4, GAP‑12). Having the minute‑level series would pin the exact onset minute and fully close the timing loop.

hypothesis.mechanism: The v5.4.0 deploy added a sector‑breakdown feature. The new code path introduces additional work (extra query / cache miss) that increases latency and produces “sector‑mapping missing” warnings, pushing portfolio‑service p99 past the edge‑gateway 3 s timeout and raising error rates.
predictions: Per‑minute portfolio‑service latency_p99_ms will show a clear inflection at or after 14:48 UTC.
Error‑rate spike will line up with the deploy minute.
Rolling back v5.4.0 will instantly restore latency to baseline (~415 ms) if this is the primary cause.

objections.detail: The deploy (14:48:30) occurs after the first downstream symptoms (market‑data latency jump at 14:41, portfolio DEADLINE_EXCEEDED at 14:42, edge‑gateway timeouts at 14:43). Cause cannot follow effect.
Observations OBS‑4, OBS‑6, OBS‑7, OBS‑8, OBS‑22‑25 show a clear upstream degradation in market‑data‑service that precedes the portfolio‑service deploy. HYP‑2 does not account for this evidence.

hypothesis.mechanism: A hidden schema migration (e.g., missing index on positions_history) makes the portfolio performance query run sequential scans, inflating latency for the /v1/portfolio path and causing downstream timeouts.
predictions: postgres-orders CPU, connection‑pool, or query‑latency metrics will show a spike coincident with the incident
A schema change will be discoverable in DB migration logs

objections.detail: The hypothesis cites no observations; all available evidence (change history, metrics, logs) points elsewhere.

actions.description: Add a short‑circuit fallback in market‑data‑service to serve cached/stale quotes when the quotes‑vendor times out, and increase the portfolio‑service gRPC deadline slightly above the vendor timeout.
actions.rationale: Immediately reduces downstream DEADLINE_EXCEEDED errors while the vendor issue is resolved.

actions.description: Retune market‑data‑service retry policy (exponential back‑off with jitter) and adjust circuit‑breaker thresholds to avoid rapid half‑open transitions under sustained vendor latency.
actions.rationale: Removes the aggressive retry loop that amplified the vendor degradation into downstream timeouts.

actions.description: Deploy alerting on market‑data‑service latency_p99_ms and error_rate spikes (e.g., >3× baseline) and expose circuit‑breaker state as a metric.
actions.rationale: Gives early warning before downstream services are impacted.

actions.description: Retrieve per‑minute portfolio‑service latency_p99_ms and error_rate series to pinpoint the exact onset minute and verify the timing loop.
actions.rationale: Closes the remaining timing gap (GAP‑4, GAP‑12) and confirms the causal chain.

actions.description: Query edge‑gateway request‑level logs for /v1/portfolio to capture detailed timeout components (network, gateway, downstream).
actions.rationale: Validates that edge‑gateway timeouts are purely downstream and not contributed by gateway processing (GAP‑5, GAP‑13).

actions.description: Confirm no hidden schema migrations or DB‑level changes occurred on postgres‑orders during the window.
actions.rationale: Rules out the rejected HYP‑3 data‑issue hypothesis (GAP‑6).
